reviews.review:
Pros:
1. The gameplay loop is super fun! It's a deck building game but it's also had a fresh and interesting approach to the genre. It boils down to getting a deck with "fight" "search" and "move" actions and efficiently using them to explore and fight back alongside your friends. There are also a few interesting puzzles and lots of rewards for explorations that grant even better cards.
2. Very fun for coop (also it can only be played in coop). There were just the 2 of us so we missed some of the "rat" mechanics when one of the players helps the host so I have no idea what's going on there but even playing the 2 of us it was fun. There are curses each player gets that make them play a certain way or lean into doing more of certain actions. You also have to cooperate constantly. There are hints that a player can get only once so each person has a unique set of hints making them share information and solve puzzles together. Some actions can only be completed by 2 people and some fights are very tough on your own. I really enjoyed the "party" aspect of the game (yet I still wish there were some solo scenarios maybe). Also the "corrupted" feature is very interactive. Sometimes your character does things that you can't control at the start of the turn like hitting another player or running adding more challenges to the experience. 
3. The artstyle, the horror aspects and the real myths and lore behind the game are such a vibe! I'm a huge fan of horror genre and I really enjoyed exploring the mansion. The spooks you're getting while being "corrupted" are amazing. You might see a new person joining the lobby or traps that are not there for example. Very cool!
4. Free friends pass for up to 4 of your friends. I mean, this already shows that the devs really care about the project and WANT you to play their game, not just get your money which is rare nowadays.

Cons:
1. Lots of bugs (cause game is in early access). Had to restart the game multiple times, which was pretty annoying but it is what it is. Was still playable, we did finish the scenario after all.
2. No way to play the game solo. I WISH I could play this more without waiting for my friends to find spare time to join me. Maybe some solo scenarios at the full release? Would have been really nice. I want to play more!
3. Only 1 scenario at the moment of writing the review.

Overall:
This was such a gem! So many unique and fresh ideas, I really enjoyed my time playing the game and I wholeheartedly recommend it. Though fair warning, there are bugs, it's early access. I wish this game success and I hope it pops off and gets discovered by more people. This game really deserves a chance and more exposure!
